div.div: 3 جاملهُ , (K,) inf. n. مُجَامَلَةٌ, (S, TA,) He coaxed him, or wheedled him, with comely behaviour or speech (بِالجَمِيلِ), not rendering him pure, or sincere, brotherly affection: (ISd, K:) or he associated with him in a good manner: (K:) or he treated him with comely behaviour. (S, TA.) One says, عَلَيْكَ بِالمُدَارَاةِ وَالمُجَامَلَةِ [Keep thou to blandishment and coaxing, &c.]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
